name: footer-privilege

frames.best_why: The whole footer is visible and the contact button is lit white, showing its hover state.

tagline: Two oversized headlines on black with one contact button at the bottom.
summary: A black footer split in two halves: a large thin "A Privilege." headline over a small logo and brand name on the left, and a dim "Beyond Reach." headline, short paragraph and contact button on the right.
appearance: A black footer divided into two columns. Left: a large thin white headline, then a small white rounded logo tile with a dark glyph beside a bold brand name. Right: a big grey headline, a four-line grey paragraph and a charcoal rounded uppercase button. A hairline separates a small spaced copyright row along the bottom.
behaviour: Nothing moves on its own. Hovering the contact button flips it from charcoal to white with black text, and the footer's colours ease if the page theme changes.
demo_content: "A Privilege." and "Beyond Reach." with Layouts Equity branding and a made-by credit.
use_when: A studio or design brand wants a stark two-column footer with oversized type and a single contact action.
avoid_when: The headlines, paragraph and brand name are fixed to this brand, so every footer needs a source edit.
customise: Headlines, paragraph, brand name, credits and the button label are hardcoded; accent colours and the hover flip need source edits.
weight_why: A static block of type and links with colour transitions on hover only.

a11y.note: The contact button is a real button but has no click handler, so it only changes colour; the credit link is the sole destination.

issues: The Contact us button has no click handler and does not lead anywhere.
The secondary headline and paragraph are very dim grey on black, low contrast.
polish_why: Bold oversized type and a clean split; the mid headline and body copy are very dim.
title: Footer Privilege
